new_claim.title: All-degree gradient criterion for Gaussian original-marker rigidity and shared ordinary-node reduction
new_claim.scope: Let P,q in C[x1,...,xn],P nonconstant,degq<=J,J>=1. Assume OUTSIDE A COMPACT SET IN COMPLEX AFFINE SPACE that normgradP>=c*normx^(J-1) and normHessP/normgradP^2 is bounded. For EVERY fixed polynomial amplitude A,no nonzero flat period of A exp(tP-q)dx is a finite sum exp(beta*t)*polynomial(t). Written proof retains all isolated degenerate critical groups,coincident critical values,full relative-pair homology and actual periods. Normalized gradient tails have normx^J=O(1+s),bounded transport differential,at most exponential volume and amplitude growth dominated by large|t|. The COMPLETE q/t deformation is controlled by a parameter field of at most linear growth,so no infinity homology is lost. Pham PartI1-4 and PartII1.1 printed26 supply the precisely credited finite Milnor decomposition and analytic density exponent alpha>-1. For standard Gaussian q of degree2,this gives EVERY original marked Phi_A either zero or not finite exponential-polynomial;equivalently every nonzero original ORDINARY moment resolvent is nonrational. Constant-coefficient differential isolation remains an original marker polynomial in P;formal seed restriction and Hien-Roucairol comparison need neither a cyclic unit nor convergence of the Wick series. Thus no nonconstant P satisfying these explicit gradient conditions is pure or safe. Smooth leading forms of every degreeD>=2 and every dimension satisfy them,with all lower terms allowed. For a cubic with finitely many ordinary projective nodes,HessF3(v) kernel Cv and F2(v)!=0 at every node imply the required linear gradient lower bound. If a pure cubic has ordinary nodes,therefore some node has F2=0;an isotropic one gives the Gaussian affine-W frame,while a nonisotropic one has the exact common residual pair P=T(uv+h)+a*u^3+d*v^3+b*u^2+c*v^2+e*u+f*v+k and FULL nondegenerate Gaussian quadratic with m=q_TT!=0,all means and cross terms retained. This unifies irreducible nodes(ad!=0),transverse line-conic(exactly one of a,d zero),and triangles(a=d=0). The residual is NOT yet excluded by this proof;only the smooth PAPER-A row and ordinary coercive gate/normal form are complete. Exact controls show ordinary tameness alone is insufficient:the pure linear null phase has a critical point x=t*ell escaping with action0 after adding Gaussian q. The radial quadratic has Phi1=1/(1-t) and a unit via time-dependent factor1-t,while no original marker has a nonzero polynomial period. Original-marker position is essential. New result is a sufficient analytic complex-polynomial criterion,not a classification of all safe phases,not a Gaussian safety-implies-purity solution and not a nonconvergent/all-ring extension. No new mathematical checker,independent replay,formal verification,external review or novelty claim.
